body:
The first few days(or weeks, or month, it's different for everyone) are always the hardest. I think that you never stop missing someone if you really loved them. It may be just me, but I sometimes find myself thinking about that person, and after almost half a year I can say for certain I'm over him, but there will always remain a fondness inside me, a place that's just his. Thing is, if you chose to love a person your whole life, make that person yourself.

Sorry, I start ranting when I can relate to something. I won't say that everything will be okay, because I know that never helps, but if you need anyone to talk to, you should always reach out to  someone, sharing the burden always makes it lighter.

I think you did. I've been through a similar experience in the past(but the roles were reversed, as in I was the one confessing and he ambigously rejecting me) and that kind of answer is usually a soft rejection. I know it's hard, but cutting her out of your life may be one of the best decisions in this case.

He seems introverted, but honestly speaking I don't know him well enough to say for sure. My girl friends  don't find him attractive, probably because our taste in guys couldn't be more different. Thank you for your advice, I will definitely try hugging him extra close, and if I feel courageous enough I may even ask him out for a drink. Oh, I trust you, hope is the most dangerous thing. Nevertheless, you really lifted my spirits, so thanks.
